reason: Aggregate gold/spoken and component-dev gains, but fixed literature regresses by one matched morpheme; strict no-domain-regression gate not met. Production model and runtime unchanged.
hypothesis: Frozen raw-neighbor guarded single-POS correction over exact production form/POS/span sequences, extending beyond Section13 exact-cache sources. No lattice changes and no form/boundary edits.

data.split: Original corpora retained separately; these references identify the training and component-dev membership. Base analyzer already trained on NIKL.

mining.correction_gold: normalize_ep(source with one raw POS replacement) equals normalize_ep(local gold)
mining.negative_gold: all other references, including already-correct outputs
mining.negative_count_unit: candidate-specific occurrences; the same eojeol can count for multiple target candidates, not distinct token negatives

selection.selection: maximum dev micro F1 with NX/SX nonnegative; ties fewer compressed bytes then rules

fixed.input_policy: strip leading/trailing whitespace exactly like analyze_batch; raw Unicode/whitespace tested separately
fixed.evaluation_correction: Initial worktree converter lacked ignored content_dict.txt; that invalid whitelist-only score is preserved separately. Rules and native predictions unchanged.

additional_asset.format: complete optional JSON sidecar; original GMDL unchanged
additional_asset.runtime_integration: native research example only; WASM/package impact unmeasured

timing.scope: loaded native Analyzer::analyze plus optional POS sidecar; excludes load, JSON and user-dictionary setup; no WASM/browser claim

native_unit_tests.scope: Unicode spans, substring, invalid span, user words, unknown source/count, short guard rejection

failure_interpretation: All changes preserve segmentation and text. Losses include noun/bound-noun, lexical/auxiliary/derivational verb, determiner/numeral and discourse-pronoun ambiguity. POS-reference mismatches are retained as losses without declaring every case a linguistic error or changing gold.

selected_rule_support.retention: Rejected learned runtime payload is temporary; preserve counts/support/gates and hashes, not the model.

runtime_contract.order: existing production analyze including old Section16, then optional research sidecar
runtime_contract.source_match: entire eojeol raw forms/POS/count/order and all token spans equal the word span
runtime_contract.edit: at most one POS per eojeol, no rule chaining; all other fields unchanged
runtime_contract.user_priority: skip when the whole surface or any source morpheme was explicitly registered
runtime_contract.guard: raw previous/following word prefix/suffix of 1-3 codepoints, full exact word, or sentence edge
runtime_contract.delivery: native research example only; no core/model/WASM/package modification

evaluation_corrections.issue: Default Python3.9 does not implement zip(strict=True)
evaluation_corrections.resolution: zip_longest plus sentinel asserts rejects any row-count mismatch

evaluation_corrections.issue: New research matcher used starts/ends predicates; truncated n-grams could have undercounted negatives
evaluation_corrections.resolution: Mine and parse only guards whose codepoint length equals requested n; short-word tests pass. Existing Section16 take(n).eq implementation was not affected.

evaluation_corrections.issue: Detached worktree omitted ignored content_dict.txt used by reverse_2025_to_2021
evaluation_corrections.resolution: Load unchanged main converter with complete ignored dictionary, record hashes, re-score frozen native dumps, assert canonical baselines. No rule or native-output changes.

limitations: Base analyzer has prior NIKL exposure; component dev is reused from previous Section16 research and is not a new independent whole-system test.
Gold9000/spoken16407 have repeated research exposure; only this new rule mining/selection excludes their labels.
The preserved token fields do not imply semantic correctness; individual sentence regressions remain.
Sidecar bytes are complete JSON/gzip/Brotli assets, not measured integrated GMDL growth; WASM/browser/package effects were not measured.
